name: Hotkey Sliding
author: Glutoblop
description: Slide the 1-8 hotbar down through every inventory row with a rebindable key, so any row can become your active hotbar.

changelog.0.2.1: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.2.0: Controls tab: Hotbar Up / Hotbar Down keys no longer shift vanilla rows (Forward); new Hotbar Input option (Press / Double Press).
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: next/previous row keys in Settings -> Controls, row indicator, inventory highlight.
